author: Predator_Hawk
body: I think we should bring back the announcement in the chat that says "[Player] broke (Left) Monument." This can be said only in the team chat because I'm guessing the reason it was taken out was so the other team doesn't know when the monument is broken unless they keep looking at the score board. If it was in the team chat then only the team could see it and it wouldn't give away that a player is on the enemy side.

replies.body:
I agree with 99250, I was on "Teres" today, and I broke a monument, but it did not say "MLGPorky has broken left", and it did not show the experience I got for it.
I broke the other two, and I had the same problem.
There was no message stating that I broke it, nor was there a message showing the experience that I received for breaking the other monuments.
